collections.title: Echoes
collections.description: A multi-volume transmedia saga tracing the collapse and rebirth of civilisations through fragmented myths.

projects.title: Echo 00 – Prelude
projects.description: The silent prologue that sets the stage for the entire Echoes universe.
projects.overview: Echo 00 is the origin point of the Echoes saga. A wordless graphic novella exploring the birth of the first Archivist and the catastrophe known only as the Dust Event.

projects.title: Echo 01 – The Archivist
projects.description: Volume one of the Echoes graphic novel series.
projects.overview: Following the sole Archivist who survived the Dust Event, Echo 01 charts a journey across a transformed landscape in search of memory and meaning.

collections.title: Fragments
collections.description: Short-form experimental comics and illustrated stories pushing the boundaries of sequential art.

projects.title: Fragment Alpha
projects.description: A 12-page wordless comic about memory and erosion.
projects.overview: Fragment Alpha uses abstract imagery and rhythmic page composition to evoke the sensation of a dissolving memory.
